summary: Iteration 537 — LOS Pricing + Group Wash + Modern Metrics (TRevPOR/RevPAG/GOPPAR) tested end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed (los-pricing, group-wash, modern-metrics, ai-pricing los_tiers regression, demand-calendar, orphan-gaps). critical_code_review_comments: los_wash_metrics.py: modern-metrics endpoint uses hardcoded 22% fixed-cost assumption and default cap fallback of 20 rooms when db.rooms is empty — document this and consider surfacing as configurable settings.
compute_los_tiers uses total_price/nights which includes any taxes/fees baked into total_price — buckets ADR may not match a pure net rate ADR; acceptable but worth a docstring note.
group-wash historical fallback (25%) is applied whenever measured_blocks == 0; this is documented in the note field — good UX.
seed_data_creation: None (used default property with 251 seed bookings)
